company_name: Shenyang Fortune Precision Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company manufactures precision components specifically for semiconductor IC equipment.
summary: Shenyang Fortune Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of precision components for the semiconductor industry, focusing on IC and photovoltaic equipment parts. The company produces over 2 million components annually and develops more than 6,000 new components each year, ensuring international standards and integrating intelligent technologies for enhanced production efficiency.
